name: Aggressive TQQQ volatility target
tagline: Always-long TQQQ at a high 0.80 volatility target, with a fast 15-session drawdown brake instead of a trend gate.
summary: TQQQ is held at all times, scaled inversely to 20-day realised volatility around a high 0.80 annualised target, with a causal 15-session drawdown brake that cuts to a 0.25 floor and a 3-session EMA to control turnover. On the 2016-2023 development window it made 40.16% CAGR / 57.77% max drawdown / 1.068 Sharpe at 1 bp, versus TQQQ's 36.72% / 82.29% / 0.82, and it still passes at 5 and 10 bp. The edge is crash avoidance rather than broad alpha: it underperforms TQQQ in every bull year and wins in 2018 and 2022.
caveat: The 40.16% dev CAGR is fragile: excluding the best year (2023) it falls to 24.57%, the edge is mostly 2022 crash avoidance, and without a 2024-2026 holdout it is not counted as above TQQQ.
